instrument.model: modulation-difference energy and concentration under additive resynthesis, v2

params.name: rate_mode
params.why: THE KNOB v1 NEVER TURNED. k bins split at ONE common rate pile the modulation difference into a single band; k bins at k rates spread it over k. v1 always used distinct rates, so the concentrating condition appears nowhere in it

params.name: subset_size
params.why: how many coincident bins are split. Under distinct rates this sets the number of occupied bands; under a common rate it moves energy without moving concentration, which is what makes the two knobs separable at all

params.name: concentration_stat
params.why: CHOSEN BY DERIVED DYNAMIC RANGE, before running: top_band_share reaches a ratio of 8.00 across the swept k against participation_ratio's 1.226. v1 used the latter with a 2.0 bar, which exceeded its reachable ratio and made the arm inert. Both are among the three the salience cell swept, so this is a choice from a pre-existing set on an analytic criterion; participation_ratio is reported alongside

params.name: band_width_hz
params.why: 1.0 Hz, as every other cell in this line, so the numbers stay comparable with the salience result this battery would decide

params.name: seed
params.why: subsets are sampled, so the battery is a random object and must be reproducible; the repo's BASE_SEED

params.name: duration_s
params.why: 2 s resolves 0.5 Hz, half the band width, so a beat cannot straddle two bands unresolved

within-ratio median |rho|, FM detune fam.name: within-ratio median |rho|, FM detune family
within-ratio median |rho|, FM detune fam.why: a Spearman magnitude scored per ratio then medianed, which is what R1 demands and what v1 violated by pooling

top_band_share, common-rate over distinc.name: top_band_share, common-rate over distinct-rate at matched k
top_band_share, common-rate over distinc.why: a ratio of concentrations. The CEILING IS DERIVED: one band gives 1.0 and k bands give 1/k, so the reachable ratio is k_max = 8.0. 1.0 is 'the knob does nothing' and is attainable, so the arm can fail

matched-energy pairs differing in concen.name: matched-energy pairs differing in concentration
matched-energy pairs differing in concen.why: a count of within-ratio pairs; 0 is attainable and the ceiling is every pair in every ratio

matched-concentration pairs differing in.name: matched-concentration pairs differing in energy
matched-concentration pairs differing in.why: the same count in the other direction, on the same ceiling

|rho| over the constructed battery.name: |rho| over the constructed battery
|rho| over the constructed battery.rival: the FM detune family, scored the same way
|rho| over the constructed battery.why: a Spearman magnitude; 0 attainable by construction and 1 by a battery that failed to decorrelate

ratios where BOTH matched-pair families.name: ratios where BOTH matched-pair families exist within the ratio
ratios where BOTH matched-pair families.why: a count over the 11 ratios; pooling manufactures spread, so the contrast must be constructible inside one
